subject: MedSys vendor intake blocking scheduled demo — next steps
body:
From: Tom Keller <tom.keller@medsyshealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling product demo (hold requested)

Hi Avery —

Thanks for scheduling the demo next week. I need to flag that Procurement has placed the demo on hold until we complete vendor onboarding and the security questionnaire.

They specifically asked for:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Security questionnaire answers (attached spreadsheet)
- Signed NDA (we upload once vendor form is accepted)

I attached the vendor onboarding PDF and the questionnaire. Procurement says they can turn this around in ~5–7 business days after we send the completed form, but we need a point of contact from Redwood who can answer questionnaire follow-ups.

Can we pause the live demo and instead schedule a quick 20–30m technical call for our security lead to ask 2–3 clarifying questions? Alternatively, a recorded demo would help keep momentum while forms are processed.

Appreciate any help — we were excited to see the Dedicated setup for our analytics team but procurement gating is stricter than expected.

—Tom
Tom Keller
Head of Platform Security
MedSys Health
[Attachment: MedSys_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: MedSys_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling product demo (hold requested)

Hi Tom — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the forms. We can absolutely support Procurement to keep this moving. Quick notes: 

- I’ll be the primary point of contact for the vendor onboarding form and we can route questionnaire follow-ups to Ben (SE) for technical detail and Marissa (Customer Success) for operational/process items.
- We have a SOC 2 summary and network/topology diagram we can share immediately; attaching the SSO instructions and a short compliance pack to speed procurement review.
- To keep momentum, we can:
  1) Record a 30-minute product walkthrough (no customer data) and share the recording and slides
  2) Schedule a short technical Q&A (20–30m) between Ben and your security lead to answer the questionnaire follow-ups

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll complete the vendor form and return it by EOD tomorrow (13 Jan).
- Ben, can you prep the SSO notes and any short evidence snippets (e.g., encryption at rest, retention controls) we typically put in these questionnaires?
- Tom/Lena — would you prefer the recorded walkthrough first, or the live tech Q&A? If live, availability windows below.

Availability windows (PST):
- Wed Jan 14, 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Thu Jan 15, 09:00–12:00

If Procurement still needs the NDA signed before any recording is shared, we’ll follow that path.

Thanks — I’ll attach the filled vendor form when complete.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0162
[Attachment: redwood_sso_instructions.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Keller <tom.keller@medsyshealth.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling product demo (hold requested)

Hi Tom — I can take the questionnaire follow-ups. A few quick clarifications so Procurement gets what they need without back-and-forth: 

- Which environment class do you want answers for (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private)? I’ll prepare answers for Dedicated (per your initial interest) but can include Hosted equivalents if helpful.
- For SSO we support OIDC + SAML; I attached a one-page SSO checklist and a sample metadata file. If you can confirm your IdP type (Okta/Azure AD), I’ll include the exact steps and sample claim mappings.
- If helpful we can stand up a temporary sandbox tenant (no PHI) for your architects to poke around; takes 1 business day to provision.

Proposed tentative demo windows (assuming onboarding completes):
- Tue Feb 3, 10:00–11:00 PST
- Wed Feb 4, 14:00–15:00 PST

If you’d rather do a technical Q&A sooner, I can do Wed Jan 21 at 11:00 PST (30m) — otherwise we’ll aim for Feb dates once Procurement confirms.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199
[Attachment: redwood_sso_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medsyshealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scheduling product demo (hold requested)

Hi all — quick update from Procurement: they acknowledged receipt of the onboarding form and questionnaire and expect to complete review by EOD Jan 22 provided no follow-up is required. They asked that Redwood be available for any clarifying questions during that window.

We prefer the live tech Q&A first so our security lead can validate a couple of items before Procurement signs off. Please confirm Ben’s Jan 21 11:00 PST slot for a 30m call — that works for our team. If Procurement clears things earlier, we’ll prioritize Feb 3 as the live demo date.

Thanks for being flexible — we’ll upload the signed NDA to the portal once Procurement completes the review.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
MedSys Health
[Attachment: (none)]
